recommendation: Check every request against the rules before it is sent
evidence: 1749 returns in the log had a reason a rule covers (Effective date too soon 361, Target position not available 185, Grade change too large for a transfer 183, Employee not in stated position 129); 141 were only found at system update. Median loop 30 working hours.

recommendation: Run org design review and budget approval in parallel for new positions
evidence: Median org design review 14.1 h and budget approval 13.4 h, run one after the other today on 805 requests.

recommendation: Detect dependent transactions at submission and sequence them
evidence: 497 requests waited on hold at system update for an average of 32 working hours.

recommendation: Balance validation work between HR Ops Airport and HR Ops Central
evidence: HR Ops Airport takes a median 8.4 working hours to validate (5278 validations) versus 4.8 for HR Ops Central.

recommendation: Replace free-text clarifications with required fields
evidence: 337 returns were general clarifications with no structured reason; median loop 38 working hours. Estimate assumes half can be prevented.

recommendation: Pre-approve budget for positions in the approved headcount plan
evidence: Finance steps take a median 15 working hours in the month-end window versus 9 otherwise (269 steps).
